test_title: PYST 19: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 18th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: According to the author, how does renewable energy alter global power dynamics?
solution: The correct answer is: **Option (3) i.e. By enabling regional energy independence**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **“enabling energy autonomy”** in the passage refers to regions or countries generating and managing their own renewable energy, making them less dependent on external fossil fuel supplies. (क्षेत्रीय ऊर्जा स्वतंत्रता सक्षम करना) • **Example:** When a country invests in solar or wind energy, it can meet its own energy needs without relying on oil imports. • This shift disrupts the traditional global power held by fossil-fuel-rich nations, redistributing energy control and influence. • Therefore, renewable energy changes global power dynamics by empowering regions to achieve energy independence. Therefore, the correct answer is- By enabling regional energy independence [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **By concentrating energy ownership** (ऊर्जा स्वामित्व को केंद्रीकृत करके): Means energy control is limited to a few entities. • **Example:** Renewable energy promotes decentralization, not concentration, of energy ownership. • **By reducing electricity demand** (बिजली की मांग को कम करके): Means lowering the need for electricity. • **Example:** The passage does not mention renewable energy reducing overall demand, but instead meeting it more sustainably. • **By increasing oil dependence** (तेल पर निर्भरता बढ़ाकर): Means relying more on oil. • **Example:** Renewable energy reduces, not increases, oil dependence. 49:Te32, The correct answer is **Option 2**.
